Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

For generations, our foundry has taken great pride in supplying our regional partners with the utmost care and quality. To continue serving you with the craftsmanship you expect from us, we must account for our rising expenses. Over the past twelve months, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost.

Taking these developments into consideration, we are pleased to present our offer for a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our long-standing relationship deeply and look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG team,

You have reminded us that you previously held prices steady for our partnership; it sounds like you want that commitment reciprocated, not taken for granted. We value that support and want an adjustment grounded in verified costs that also recognises your cash-flow interests. How could faster payment help us agree a cost-based price adjustment and a workable transition?

We confirm a binding volume of 8,150 units per year for 12 months. Using your own cost shares (LCI-C 30%, PPI-C241 24%) and the latest six-month index moves (LCI-C +1.7%, PPI-C241 +6.2%), your cost increase comes to about +2.0% of the price, not +9.5%. Our should-cost estimate for Volute casing HN 50-200 is EUR 132.64 per 1 (cost:310010). Producer prices DE: basic iron and steel, ferro-alloys changed -4.3% from 2024-10 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C241@2024-10, idx:PPI-C241@2025-10). Straight talk: over the last 12 months we paid 86% of your invoices late, on average 3 days after the due date. That is on us, and it ends with this contract: every invoice paid on the due date, which brings your cash in about 3 days earlier than you are used to.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 127.31 per unit, from 2027-01-01, 14 days payment). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €134.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 January 2027.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We did not know that - a fair point.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains.
We appreciate your offer of 14-day payment terms and the commitment to timely settlement, which we are pleased to accept.
While we acknowledge the index movements you referenced, our overall operational costs remain substantial and require a sustainable price.
We therefore propose €134.50 per unit, effective 1 January 2027, reflecting a significant concession to honour our long-standing partnership.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
